Marissa / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Datadog is very interested in a tighter integration with Redwood’s inference runtime — specifically on metrics ingestion, span tagging for long-running generation requests, and a lightweight SDK that our mutual customers can drop into their pipelines.

We sketched a short mutual action plan and attached it (RWD-Datadog-MAP.xlsx). High level asks from our side:
- Formalize a tiny SDK (Python + Go) that exports per-request latency + token counts and emits OTLP-compatible traces.
- Agreement on semantic conventions for "model.name", "model.version", and "inference.batch_size" so dashboards line up.
- A playbook for staging vs prod routing for Dedicated customers (we can help with runbooks).

Would Redwood be open to a co-engineering kickoff next month? We can commit two engineers post-signing of the MOU / SOW.

Best,
